dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uh, but, hehe... Why are you a Doctor? How's a Doctor... gonna perform a sneak attack?

choices.text: I can attack with medicinal products.

response.speaker: "Game Master"
response.text: Your medicine box does indeed contain items with high toxicity and anesthetic properties.

choices.text: I can knock them out with my heavy medicine box.

response.speaker: "Game Master"
response.text: Hmm, I've calculated the weight of your medicine box, and yes, that would work.

response.speaker: "Game Master"
response.text: Furthermore, after throwing the medicine box, the highly toxic and anesthetic substances stored inside will be considered as having been thrown at the target as well.
